I'd steer clear of it. DMAA is a stimulant that's banned in most countries and by most sports bodies, and regulators have pulled it from shelves over cardiovascular safety concerns. A preworkout that still lists it is usually one to be wary of, including what's actually in the tub.

For what it's worth, a good night's sleep, a meal an hour or two before, and a solid warm-up do more for a session than any scoop. I won't speak to amounts of any stimulant, so if you're weighing a preworkout of any kind, run it by a doctor or dietitian first.

If your energy is dragging in the gym, tell me when in the day you train and how you've been sleeping, and we can look at that side of it.
